mapper.select: SELECT id, account, name, tenant_id, status, audiences, expires_at, revision FROM iam.service_accounts WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, account, name, tenant_id, status, audiences, expires_at, revision FROM iam.service_accounts WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

INSERT INTO iam.service_accounts(account, name, tenant_id, status, audiences, expires_at, revision, created_by) VALUES (#{account}, #{name}, #{tenantId}, 'active', #{audiences,jdbcType=ARRAY,typeHandler=com.airagent.iam.common.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}, #{expiresAt}, 1, #{actorId}) RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam.service_account_permissions(tenant_id, service_account_id, permission_id, granted_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{id}, #{permissionId}, #{actorId})
mapper.select: SELECT credential_revision, expires_at, overlap_until FROM iam_auth.issue_service_token(#{id}, #{credentialId}, #{digest}, #{expiresAt}, #{overlapUntil,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE})
SELECT id, account, name, tenant_id, status, audiences, expires_at, revision FROM iam.service_accounts tenant_id = #{tenantId}AND id > #{afterId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{fetchSize}
SELECT credential_id, credential_revision, status, issued_at, expires_at, overlap_until, revoked_at FROM iam_auth.list_service_tokens(#{id})
mapper.update: UPDATE iam.service_accounts SET status = #{status}, revoked_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'disabled' THEN COALESCE(revoked_at, now()) ELSE NULL END, revision = revision + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.code FROM iam.service_account_permissions sap JOIN iam.permissions p ON p.id = sap.permission_id WHERE sap.service_account_id = #{id} ORDER BY p.code
SELECT id FROM iam.permissions WHERE status = 'active' AND resource_code IS NULL AND scope = 'tenant' AND code IN #{code}
